question: What security and ownership boundary should a Dashboard browser preview use before implementation?
rationale: The requested panel would expose sensitive browser state and may live either as first-party Control UI or browser-plugin UI, so automation cannot safely choose the trust model or product boundary.

options.title: Read-only-first admin panel
options.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs, while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credential fields, and submits.

options.title: Wait for plugin UI entry points
options.body: Defer browser-specific UI until the generic plugin UI entry-point contract is accepted, then implement the panel as browser-plugin-owned UI.

options.title: Defer live preview
options.body: Keep the current CLI/RPC screenshot workflow until remote browser preview becomes a prioritized product area.

recommendation.title: Read-only-first admin panel
recommendation.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs, while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credential fields, and submits.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal across browser runtime, Control UI routing, browser docs, and the existing issue discussion.
